lean.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 3 ≤ n → ∀ {κ : ℝ}, 4 ≤ κ → ∀ (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ), let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := ((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose); A.IsHermitian ∧ ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) ∧ v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) ≤ κ * (v ⬝ᵥ v)
approved_definition_context: The let-bound matrix is the anonymous literal expansion of the definition used by the compiled proposition.
Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ is the real orthogonal group, with transpose(O)*O=I.
Over ℝ, IsHermitian is equality to the transpose. dotProduct is the sum of coordinate products and mulVec is ordinary matrix-vector multiplication.
